source.oltp.note: A globally distributed relational database that combines SQL with horizontal scale, offered with GoogleSQL or PostgreSQL dialects.

bands.note: Multi-region replication, automatic failover and dynamic scaling, so the customer runs no replicas. It manages the database's infrastructure, not yours.

proposed_capabilities.name: Source-side change stream
proposed_capabilities.description: A change feed the database itself exposes, so downstream tools can read row-level changes without a separate CDC product. Scored here as a source feature rather than as ingestion.

presentation.tagline: Globally distributed relational database with strong consistency.
